interface.title: SpatialAIM GUI (SpatialAIM results explorer)
interface.field: Spatial transcriptomics / single-cell genomics (mapping scRNA-seq cell states onto imaging-based spatial data)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and model selection: mapping cells to states, then choosing how many cell types (K) map reliably
interface.what_it_is_for: Load a raw-count scRNA reference and a spatial transcriptomics slice, over-cluster and agglomerate the reference, map spots to cell states with one or more mappers across every K, and pick the cell-state granularity that maps most reliably, judged by reconstruction, spatial organisation and transcriptional coherence.

data.note: I typed the repo sample paths into the sidebar: sample_dataset/scRNA/sample_sc.h5ad, sample_dataset/ST/sample_st.h5ad, and output sample_output/sample. Validation said the pair was usable but warned 'only 5 shared genes (expected > 10)'. The dataset is tiny (about 10 spatial cells; Leiden gave K 1–14). Because of this, every score on the Overview table read 'None', and wann mapped nearly every spot to one type. The 📁 Browse buttons cannot work here: 'File dialog unavailable: no $DISPLAY'.

tree.general: Find the number of cell types from a single-cell reference that can be reliably placed onto a spatial tissue map
tree.specific: Run the SpatialAIM Leiden + agglomeration sweep with nearest_centroid and wann, then pick K using Overview, Explore and Compare, and interpret the chosen cell types in Explore and Single-cell reference
